patient_persona.description: Mr. Khoo Beng Huat, 78, male, retired goldsmith in George Town, Penang; day 3 in the medical ward on IV antibiotics. Weak, raspy voice, Penang Mandarin with Hokkien words and a little Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Teoh Pei Shan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical registrar at Hospital Pulau Pinang, on the morning ward round. Kind but brisk; Mandarin with English ward terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 早安，Khoo 伯伯。今天第三天了，感觉怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 比较好了，医生。昨晚没有发烧，咳嗽也少一点，但是还是 lembik，没什么力。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 temperature 从昨天早上到现在都 normal，oxygen 96 percent on room air，已经不用 nasal prong 了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我几时可以 balik rumah？我的孙子礼拜天生日。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 blood culture 没有长细菌，CRP 从 180 降到 60，这个是好的 sign。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果今天吃东西 okay，明天我们可以把 IV ceftriaxone 换成吃的 antibiotic。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 吃什么药？我吃太多药会胃痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 625mg，一天两次，饭后吃，再吃五天。Azithromycin 已经吃够三天了，可以停。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。医生，我吞东西的时候有时候会呛到，喝水特别容易，especially 喝热茶。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个很重要，谢谢你讲。有时候肺炎是因为东西呛进肺里面。我请 speech therapist 今天来看你吞东西。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要做手术吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不用，只是看看怎样吃比较安全，可能喝水要加一点 thickener。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦，这样。那我明天可以 discharge 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 先看 speech therapist 的 assessment，还有你今天走路的情况。Physio 会带你走一走。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦，我会乖乖走路。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好。有什么不舒服，按铃叫护士。

patient_persona.description: Ganesan a/l Subramaniam, 45, male, forklift operator at a Port Klang warehouse; smokes 20 cigarettes a day. Gravelly voice, fast Malaysian Indian English with Malay words, coughs between sentences.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Hafiz Rosli, Malay man in his 40s, family physician at a Klang polyclinic. Firm, friendly; English mixed with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Ganesan, your chest X-ray dah keluar. Come, see here, this white patch at the right bottom. That's pneumonia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, pneumonia? I thought just batuk biasa, doc. One week already cannot sleep.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your temperature is 38.4 and oxygen 95 percent. Your CURB-65 score rendah, so you can go home with oral antibiotics.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, good, because esok night shift. Can work or not?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak boleh. Forklift and fever is not a good combination. I give you MC one week.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 625mg, twice a day, after food, for seven days. Tambah doxycycline 100mg, twice a day, also seven days.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: The doxy one, got any pantang? My wife say some antibiotic cannot take with milk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Correct. Doxycycline jangan makan dengan susu or antacid, take with a full glass of water and don't lie down for thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, faham. Anything else, doc?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The smoking. Twenty batang a day, your lungs are having a very hard time. This is a good time to stop.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hmm, susah lah doc. Twenty years already, since zaman estate.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I know. We have a quit smoking clinic here every Rabu, free. Can I put your name down?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, try lah. My daughter also bising every day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Datang balik in two days for review, and repeat X-ray in six weeks. If sesak nafas or chest pain, go straight to Hospital Tengku Ampuan Rahimah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doc, thank you.

patient_persona.description: Puan Wan Zaleha binti Wan Ahmad, 60, female, retired nurse from Kuala Terengganu; type 2 diabetes on insulin; day 4 in ward. Clear, knowledgeable, Terengganu Malay, uses English medical terms from her nursing years.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Jun Hao, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, medical officer at Hospital Sultanah Nur Zahirah, ward round. Polite, systematic; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selamat pagi, Puan Zaleha. Macam mana hari ni? Batuk dah kurang?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pagi, doktor. Batuk dah kurang, kahak pun dah tak kuning macam dulu. Tapi sugar saya tinggi sangat semalam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, saya nampak dalam chart, pukul sepuluh malam 18. Sebab infection pun boleh naikkan gula.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya faham. Masa saya nurse dulu, selalu jumpa pesakit macam ni. Insulin kena naikkan ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, kita naikkan insulin basal dari 14 unit ke 16 unit malam ni, dan teruskan sliding scale.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sputum culture dah keluar, Streptococcus pneumoniae, sensitive kepada penicillin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jadi boleh tukar kepada oral antibiotic?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. Demam dah hilang 48 jam, jadi kita tukar IV ke oral amoxicillin 1 gram, tiga kali sehari, tiga hari lagi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh discharge? Suami saya kat rumah sorang-sorang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau gula stabil malam ni, insya-Allah esok boleh discharge. Klinik diabetes akan follow up minggu depan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oxygen saya berapa hari ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 97 percent, room air. Paru-paru dah lebih bersih, cuma sikit crackles kat bawah kiri.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Vaksin pneumonia tu, saya patut ambil tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Patut, puan. Dengan diabetes dan umur 60, pneumococcal vaccine sangat disyorkan. Kita boleh bagi masa follow up nanti.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Terima kasih.

patient_persona.description: Puan Nor Azlina binti Hashim, 29, female, factory operator in Alor Setar, Kedah, bringing her son Aqil, 3, with fever and fast breathing. Worried, quick Kedah Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Sharmila Devi, Malaysian Indian woman in her 30s, medical officer in the paediatric clinic at Hospital Sultanah Bahiyah. Calm and warm; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, anak saya demam tiga hari, batuk teruk. Malam tadi nafas dia laju sangat, breathing macam tercungap-cungap, saya takut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita tengok dulu. Aqil makan minum macam mana? Ada vomit?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susu minum sikit je, nasi tak nak langsung. Muntah sekali lepas batuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Respiratory rate dia 44, oxygen 95 percent. Ada crackles dekat paru-paru kanan. X-ray tunjuk pneumonia, jangkitan paru-paru.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya Allah. Kena admit ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buat masa ni oxygen dia okay, dia tak dehydrated, dada dia tak tertarik ke dalam. So boleh rawat kat rumah, tapi kena ikut betul-betul.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Berat Aqil 14kg. Saya bagi amoxicillin syrup 250mg per 5ml, 7ml tiga kali sehari, lima hari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tujuh ml, tiga kali sehari. Kena habiskan semua ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, habiskan lima hari walaupun dia dah okay. Paracetamol syrup 7ml bila demam, setiap enam jam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh bagi cough syrup tak? Batuk dia kuat sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat batuk tak digalakkan untuk budak bawah enam tahun. Batuk tu membantu keluarkan kahak. Bagi minum air sikit-sikit tapi kerap, small sips.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Bila kena bawa balik untuk review?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Datang balik dalam 48 jam untuk review. Tapi kalau nafas makin laju, bibir biru, atau dia sangat lembik, terus pergi emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Terima kasih banyak.

patient_persona.description: Chong Jia Hui, 30, female, marketing executive in Petaling Jaya; two-week cough, follow-up after starting doxycycline. Lively, fast, KL Mandarin heavily mixed with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Raymond Lau, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, GP at a PJ clinic. Relaxed, clear; mixes English and Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jia Hui，上次的 X-ray 和 blood test 都出来了。你那个是 atypical pneumonia，很可能是 mycoplasma。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mycoplasma？那个是什么东西？会传染给我 office 的人吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 是一种细菌，叫 walking pneumonia，因为很多人还可以照常走来走去。会传染，但是没有 COVID 那么厉害。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 难怪我 cough 了两个礼拜都不好。Doxycycline 我吃了三天，现在好很多了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good。你现在还有发烧吗？晚上睡得着吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有发烧了，但是晚上还是会 cough，especially 躺下来的时候。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个 cough 可能会拖几个礼拜，因为 airway 还在 recover。Doxycycline 继续吃完七天，100mg 一天两次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对了，我吃了之后去晒太阳，手臂变得很红很痒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Doxycycline 会让皮肤对太阳 sensitive。出去的时候涂 sunblock，穿长袖，尽量避开中午的太阳。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦，原来是这样。我周末要去 Port Dickson 海边，那我还可以去吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，但是要做好 sun protection，还有不要跟 antacid 或者牛奶一起吃药。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay noted。我下个礼拜需要回来吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 两个礼拜后回来 review。四到六个礼拜后我们再照一次 X-ray，确定肺部 clear 了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢 doctor。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果 cough 越来越严重，或者喘不过气，就早点回来，不用等。

patient_persona.description: Pak Cik Che Mat bin Yusof, 65, male, retired padi farmer in Pasir Mas, Kelantan; hypertension and high cholesterol on amlodipine and simvastatin. Slow, deep Kelantan Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Farah Nadia Abdul Karim, Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at a klinik kesihatan in Pasir Mas. Gentle, thorough; Malay with English drug names.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik, test COVID pagi tadi positif. Bila mula tak sihat?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Semalam, doktor. Tekak gatal, badan lenguh, demam sikit. Cucu saya dari KL balik rumah minggu lepas, dia pun batuk, tapi tak test.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik umur 65 dan ada darah tinggi, jadi pak cik dalam kumpulan risiko tinggi. Kita akan bagi ubat antiviral, nama dia Paxlovid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Paxlovid? Ubat baru ke tu? Saya dah makan banyak ubat, doktor, pressure, cholesterol.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat ni kena makan lima hari. Tapi ada satu masalah, dia tak boleh makan sama dengan simvastatin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Habis tu simvastatin saya macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop simvastatin selama lima hari makan Paxlovid, dan tiga hari lepas tu. Lepas tu mula balik macam biasa. Amlodipine teruskan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, berhenti sekejap je. Paxlovid tu makan macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Satu pek ada tiga biji. Pagi tiga biji, malam tiga biji, lima hari. Telan terus, jangan kunyah, jangan break.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rasa ubat tu pahit ke? Kawan saya kata lidah rasa pelik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, ada yang rasa pahit atau macam besi dalam mulut. Itu biasa, akan hilang lepas habis course ubat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Oxygen pak cik 97 percent, paru-paru okay. Duduk dalam bilik asing, pakai mask bila jumpa orang rumah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Isteri saya pun dah tua, 62. Dia kena test juga?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau dia ada simptom, suruh dia buat RTK-Ag. Kalau pak cik sesak nafas atau oxygen bawah 95, terus pergi Hospital Pasir Mas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Terima kasih.

patient_persona.description: Marcus Tan, 27, male, software developer in Bangsar South, Kuala Lumpur; fully vaccinated, no medical problems. Casual Malaysian English, some Mandarin and Malay filler.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nadia Zulkifli, Malay woman in her 30s, telemedicine GP based in Kuala Lumpur. Upbeat, efficient; English with bits of Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Marcus, I can see your test photo. Two lines, so yes, COVID positive. How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Not too bad lah. Throat quite sore, a bit panas last night, 37.9. Just very tired, badan lemah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any breathlessness, chest pain, or feeling dizzy when you stand?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, none of that. Mostly I'm worried about kerja. We have a product launch minggu depan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You're young and fully vaccinated, so this is likely mild. You don't need antiviral pills.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So just Panadol can already, doc?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes. Paracetamol 1 gram, every six hours kalau perlu. Strepsils or warm salt water for the throat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. How many days I need to isolate? My housemate also takut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stay home until you're fever-free for 24 hours and feeling better, usually about five hari. Pakai mask around your housemate.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I still work from home? Macam laptop in bed like that.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You can, if you feel okay. But I'm giving you a five-day MC, so no pressure to log in.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Haha, my boss confirm WhatsApp me anyway.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Then mute Slack sekejap. Rest is what gets you better faster.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, noted. Anything I need to watch out for?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If you get breathless, chest pain, or your fever goes on past five days, call us or go to the nearest hospital.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright, thanks doc.

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Goh Ah Moi, 70, female, retired sundry-shop owner in Kluang, Johor; had COVID six weeks ago. Soft, slow voice, Mandarin with Hokkien words and a little Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Azlan Kamarudin, Malay man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Kluang health clinic who speaks Mandarin learnt from school friends. Patient and gentle; Mandarin with English and Malay terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Goh 阿姨，COVID 已经六个礼拜了，现在还有什么不舒服？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，咳嗽还没好，干干的。走路去 pasar 一下就很累，要坐下来休息。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 晚上睡觉的时候会不会喘？躺平可以吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 躺平可以。就是喉咙痒，一痒就咳，咳到想吐。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我刚才看你的 oxygen，坐着 97，走六分钟以后 95，这个 okay。你的 X-ray 也 clear。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那为什么我还是那么累？我以前每天都去 senam 的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个叫 post-COVID syndrome，有些人会累好几个月，但是慢慢会好起来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 运动不要一下子做太多。先走十分钟，觉得 okay 了，每个礼拜加一点。累的话隔天就 rest。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 咳嗽有什么药可以吃？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 咳嗽可能是 airway 还很敏感。我开 budesonide inhaler 给你试，早晚各一下，喷完要漱口。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 喷的药我不会用，以前没用过。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 没关系，药剂师会教你，用 spacer 会比较容易。还有，你的血也要验一下，看有没有贫血或者 thyroid 问题。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。那我还可以帮忙带孙子吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，但是不要抱太重。如果 chest pain、心跳很快、或者脚肿，就要早点回来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的，谢谢医生，terima kasih ya。

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Kalaivani a/p Suppiah, 32, female, primary school teacher in Seremban, 24 weeks pregnant with her first baby. Anxious, soft-spoken Malaysian Indian English with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wong Mei Kuan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, O&G medical officer at Hospital Tuanku Ja'afar antenatal clinic. Reassuring, clear; English with Malay for instructions.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my RTK came positive pagi tadi. I'm so scared for the baby.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I understand. Let's go through it slowly. What symptoms do you have?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sore throat, hidung berair, a bit demam last night, 38.1. Not much batuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any sesak nafas, chest pain, bleeding or leaking water from below?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that. Baby still menendang, quite active this morning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Your oxygen is 98 percent, BP 112 over 70. Baby's heartbeat on the doppler is 148, very nice, sangat bagus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I take Panadol? I read online tak boleh makan ubat when pregnant.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol is safe in pregnancy. One gram up to four times a day. Tapi jangan ambil ibuprofen or any Nurofen, those are not suitable now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Will the baby get infected?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's rare for the baby to be affected in mild cases like yours. Your vaccines dulu help protect you both.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rest at home, minum air banyak. Wear a mask around your husband and mother-in-law.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My mother-in-law says must eat certain herbs, jamu and all that. Is it okay?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Please avoid any herbal or ubat tradisional for now, kita tak tahu apa dalam tu. Normal food is best.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Bila I should come back?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Keep your antenatal appointment in two weeks. But if you feel sesak nafas, baby moves less, or fever above 39, come straight to the labour room.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. I feel a bit lega now.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Ting Kah Ming, 50, male, Foochow timber-yard manager in Sibu, Sarawak; obese, type 2 diabetes; day 5 in the COVID ward on oxygen. Tired, breathy voice, Sarawak Mandarin with English and Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Sim Hock Leong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, physician at Hospital Sibu, on the ward round. Steady, reassuring; Mandarin with English clinical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ting 先生，早。今天呼吸怎样？比较不喘吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好一点了，医生。昨天去 toilet 回来喘到不行，今天比较 okay。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你现在 oxygen 用两升 nasal prong，saturation 95。昨天是四升，所以有进步。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那几时可以拿掉这个管子？我好想回家了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们每天慢慢降。如果降到 room air 还有 94 以上，就可以考虑回家。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dexamethasone 6mg 每天一次，今天是第五天，要吃满十天，或者你出院就停。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个药让我的血糖很高，护士一直来打针。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，steroid 会让糖升高，所以我们用 insulin sliding scale。出院以后糖就会慢慢降回来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我肚子每天打的那一针是什么？很痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那是 enoxaparin 60mg，防止血栓。COVID 的人很容易血管里面有 blood clot，所以要打。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦，原来是这样。我老婆也可以来看我吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这里是 COVID ward，现在还不能探病。你可以用 video call，护士可以帮你。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦。医生，我的肺会完全好吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 大部分人会慢慢恢复。出院后六到八个礼拜我们再照 X-ray，看 lung 有没有 scarring。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生，我会继续做呼吸运动。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好，那个 incentive spirometer 一个钟头吹十次，physio 也会来帮你。
